request_notes: 网关为 gpt-image-2 的 OpenAI 兼容中转（Plinth 的 OPENAI_BASE_URL）；为压低费用每个付费端点只发一次，取 1024x1024、quality=low、n=1：Plinth 默认 2048x2048、quality=max，响应结构相同，只有 usage 的数值不同。
edits 的参考图在付费运行里用的是 `image[]` 分片名（Plinth 的真实写法，网关返回 200）；wirefixture 的键规则不接受方括号，样本把分片名写成 `image`，fake 两种写法都接受。

内容审核拒绝（400 moderation_blocked）与 402 没有在官方网关上触发，fake 沿用真实 400 信封并换成文档里的 code 与 message；quota-exceeded 429（error.quota 信封）与 forbidden 403（eca_access_denied）依据仓库内已记录的真实网关响应构造，service-unavailable 503 依据官方错误码指南构造（2026-11-08 核对）。

endpoints.note: JSON request with inline base64 pictures; n is documented by the official Create image reference (1–10) and returns that many distinct inline candidates; the committed samples ask for n=1, so n>1 is constructed-from-docs. 400 missing_required_parameter and 401 text/plain are real samples. A content-policy refusal (400 moderation_blocked) and the 402/500 faults are not observed: they reuse the real 400 envelope with the documented code or message. The quota-exceeded 429 (the gateway's error.quota body), forbidden 403 (the gateway's eca_access_denied) and service-unavailable 503 (documented service_unavailable_error/server_is_overloaded) are constructed-from-docs answers built from the recorded gateway refusals and the error-code guide (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes, checked 2026-11-08)

multipart request with the reference picture in the image part (Plinth sends image[], the committed sample says image because the sample key rule rejects brackets; the fake accepts both). model is optional on this route, per the official Create image edit reference (default gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, checked 2026-11-08); the same constructed-from-docs 403/429/503 faults as generations apply
